csv_agency: Town of East Montpelier Municipal Offices
csv_scope_of_work: The Town of East Montpelier seeks qualified engineering and design services to develop a scoping study for a sidewalk extension along Vermont Route 14. This project aims to establish a safe, accessible Pedestrian and Bicycle Sidewalk Plan connecting the Upper and Lower Village centers.
